Description.value: Plays your own sound clips: blood moon horde (and/or a warning earlier that day), when you enter the world, morning and night bells at this world's dawn and dusk, and a survived fanfare after the blood moon. Shows a blood moon countdown, a warning banner and an optional red pulse on screen, with an in-game settings window. Drop bloodmoon / spawn / morning / night / survived as .ogg, .wav, or .mp3 into this folder (several of a kind play at random). Players: the server does not need it. Server (optional): posts blood moon updates, live countdowns, death alerts, a horde recap with awards, records, streaks and a weekly leaderboard to Discord and game chat, answers /bm in chat (see discord.example.txt); players do not need it for that.
